text:
Maria P (Partnerships): FYI NordicCompute + VectorWorks want a short pilot using a LangChain adapter + our gateway. They asked for marketplace assets and a co-demo during the week of May 12.

Raj K (Eng): Clarify scope: LangChain adapter only or LlamaIndex connectors too? Need perf matrix.

Maria P (Partnerships): LangChain adapter + 1 sample showing routing + autoscale. VectorWorks will run E2E on Nordic hardware.

Ben T (DevEx): I can scaffold the sample quickstart and push a PR tonight. Will include a fallback demo.

Sophie L (Product): Marketplace checklist: SKU, pricing guidance, support matrix, security notes for Private. I'll draft SKU mapping by May 3.

Claire M (Marketing): Need perf numbers for the one-pager and a 90s co-demo script. Can we target tech sign-off May 1, legal May 5?

Anita R (Legal): Yes. Send dataflow + draft coop wording. Recommend using "Validated on NordicCompute" not "Certified" unless formal audit is done.

Raj K (Eng): For perf: test models redwood-7b and redwood-13b-q4; seq 512 & 2048; batch 1,4,8. OpsBot queue?

OpsBot: Perf job queued. Provide GCS path and CSV of prompts, tag: nordic-vector-1735.

Ben T (DevEx): Uploading prompts and repo: gs://redwood-partners/nordic-vector-1735. PR: https://github.com/redwood-repo/vectorworks-quickstart/pull/9

Raj K (Eng): Note: older Nordic kernels cause KV cache issues. Workaround: export REDWOOD_KV_SHMEM=0. I'll paste repro in the repo.

Maria P (Partnerships): Good. Action items: Raj (compat + perf), Ben (repo + prompts), Sophie (SKU), Anita (legal), Claire (marketing). Check-in Friday 10am PT. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
